{{nymph|parent=[[Mediterranus]]}}Nileus, God of the Nile River - Nileus is a powerful and revered god, ruling over the majestic Nile River, the longest river in Africa. He is often depicted as a regal figure, adorned with symbols of fertility and abundance, such as the lotus flower and the crook and flail. Nileus is believed to control the annual flooding of the Nile River, which brings life-giving waters and fertile soil to the surrounding lands, enabling agriculture and sustaining civilizations. He is also associated with wisdom, fertility, and the cycle of life and death, as the Nile River has been a cradle of ancient civilizations for thousands of years.
